name: dmengine-fumo-download
description: Mode C FUMO download: after the authenticated SyncML handshake the mock serves an OMA Download Descriptor; the OEM confirmation command code 10 (DMC_REQ_DL_OK) lets the real dmengine fetch the described DP object (108-byte DP with a component entry and string table). The engine logs DL session complete and advances FUMO state 30 -> 40 (and to 50 in this run). The DP is a structural lab fixture and no install or update-success claim is made.
